name: SocialRouter
tagline: One API to extract data from any social network, with automatic provider failover.
shortDescription: SocialRouter is a unified API for extracting profiles, posts, comments, reviews, jobs, and places from LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Reddit, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, Bluesky, Snapchat, and Google Maps. One request with a provider slug returns a normalized response, and SocialRouter transparently fails over to a compatible provider on error.
agentSummary: Agents extract social and web data through a single REST endpoint, an official npm SDK, CLI, or MCP server. The provider catalogue and per-record pricing are queryable before a call, and credits are pay-per-record so an agent can compare providers and pin the cheapest or fastest.
bestFor: Extracting normalized social media and Google Maps data across many providers without integrating each scraping actor separately.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: Extractions are billed per record returned against whichever provider succeeds, so an agent should set a sensible `limit` and watch credit balance before large jobs. Scraping social platforms may be subject to each platform's terms and regional data rules; review compliance before delegating bulk extraction. The Vercel function timeout caps long-running extractions at 300s, and the in-memory rate limiter is advisory. Verify provider availability and pricing via `GET /v1/providers` before automating.
pricingSummary: Pay-as-you-go credits denominated in USD, charged per record returned. No subscriptions or minimums. Per-record price varies by provider, platform, and extraction type; the live price on `GET /v1/providers` is the price paid.
authModel: Bearer API keys prefixed `sr_live_`, created in the dashboard and shown once. 60 requests/minute per key, with optional per-key credit limits. Listing providers is public; all other endpoints require auth.
accountCreation: Self-serve signup at socialrouter.io; create API keys from the dashboard.
browserSupport: Web dashboard handles signup, API key management, credit top-ups, and a browsable provider catalogue with copy-ready slugs.

capabilities.detail: REST API with `POST /v1/extract`, `POST /v1/search`, provider catalogue, balance, and usage endpoints; Bearer auth and normalized responses.

Official `@socialrouter/mcp` server exposes extract, search, list_providers, get_provider, get_extraction, get_balance, and get_usage tools for Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, and other MCP clients.
Official `@socialrouter/cli` npm package runs extractions, browses providers, and checks the account from the terminal; configured via the SOCIALROUTER_API_KEY env var.
Mintlify docs cover quickstart, authentication, concepts, an interactive API reference, and dedicated SDK, CLI, and MCP guides.
Pay-per-record pricing is documented and queryable per provider via `GET /v1/providers`; the published rate is the rate charged with no hidden multipliers.
Self-serve signup, then create `sr_live_` API keys from the dashboard.
Dashboard manages keys, credits, and usage; a browsable provider list at socialrouter.io/providers exposes copy-ready slugs.

No sandbox, test mode, or dry-run is documented. Every extract/search call runs against live providers and is billed against the account's real paid credit balance, so an agent cannot rehearse a call for free.
